headSubject: ledger: session handoff 2026-11-10 (second part) -- REG-322 and REG-324 done, REG-325 open, what is next
summary: Session of 2026-11-10 (fourth part): fixed REG-325 (Manager 0.13.36). workspace.js now flags the synthetic change it fires to put its app in a picker (event.npdevFromWorkspace); browserai.js ignores flagged events and remembers an intent the person chose with the two buttons (S.intentByHand), so with an app selected a NEW app stays a new app. Added a render-check case (365/365, proven red by undoing the listener change), proved it on the real window (reg325-tour/tour.mjs 14/14, app selected, never cleared), built and silently installed Manager 0.13.36 and probed the INSTALLED exe over CDP (it serves the fix). REG-325 closed DONE in the ledger with a guard; CHANGELOG and the three version files bumped. REG-321 (a gap, not a bug) and REG-323/F4 were NOT started: F4 state is only that relay-ingest-policy.json already lists the f4 phase, nothing behind it exists except the CLI half of T4.6.
nextStep: FIRST: nothing from this session is committed or pushed. 9 files are modified (CHANGELOG.md, NPDevManager/Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, ui/browserai.js, ui/workspace.js, scripts/quality/check-manager-ui-render.mjs, ledger/items/REG-325.yml plus ledger/session-state). Check the background aiKnowledge gate (started with python scripts/ai/run_digest.py -- pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-all-gates.ps1 -Only aiKnowledge): read the newest log in D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\Build\digest-logs\ for its verdict; if the session ended before it finished, rerun it. Then pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/hygiene/clean-workspace-state.ps1, commit all of it on main with a message naming REG-325 and Manager 0.13.36, git push origin main (no branch, no PR). THEN ask the owner what they saw testing 0.13.36 on the real window with the chat AIs (they never said whether they had started; testh2s-2 is preselected in the workspace bar, Trocar de app changes it). Only on the owner go-ahead: REG-321 (npdev upgrade --app must pass the itemized acknowledgment token to the boot step, then the Manager wiring; larger, destructive-data, needs a real-window proof with a second app) and REG-323/F4 (T4.2 element upsert first). The owner also left three readiness questions in c:\Users\dev1m\Desktop\data.txt lines 480-484, still unanswered: (1) is NPDev ready for an Uber-like backend through a browser AI (likely too big for one whole-file answer until F4 T4.2 exists), (2) can a chat AI be handed one briefing file with the tool explanation, schemas and examples to build a delivery-app model (PedidosYa/iFood style), (3) is there an online repo for packs (publish-pack-repo.py only publishes to a LOCAL git repo under Build/npdev-pack-repo as far as CLAUDE.md says). Answer them from the code (relay prompt composer NPDevCli/npdev_relay_prompts.py, NPDevContract/packs, scripts/pack-repo/) before claiming anything, in Portuguese.
blocked: Owner: (1) the pilot/calibration with the 7 chat AIs (log D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\BROWSER_AI_RELAY_PLAN_2026-11-09\impl\calibration\calibration-log.csv; rows from python D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General\NPDevCli\npdev_cli.py ai relay stats --csv); (2) go-ahead for REG-321 and for F4 (REG-323; T4.4 code quarantine only with the owner); (3) the two tour leftovers PTXR and 6BG2 in the real session store (Home offers them as conversations in progress; npdev ai relay abort --code X closes one; asked, no answer); (4) stash@{0} holds only a stale CHANGELOG copy, drop when the owner agrees.
verified: Render check scripts/quality/check-manager-ui-render.mjs 365/365 on the final code (and with the listener change undone it aborts in the new REG-325 case: proven red). Real-window tour D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\reg325-tour\tour.mjs 14/14 on the freshly built exe, real CLI and generator, app selected, plus the window itself confirmed it serves the new code. Installed 0.13.36 (registry lists it, installer exit 0) probed over CDP with probe-installed.mjs: serves the flag in both scripts; its SHA-256 differs from the Build exe, which is why the installed one was probed. python scripts/quality/check-done-item-guards.py --no-baseline-ok: 0 blocking findings; check-ledger-status-reverse-freshness.py OK. NOT verified: the aiKnowledge gate was started in the background and no verdict had been seen at close; no T2 gate ran; the owner has not used 0.13.36 and no real chat AI was involved (the tour used canned answers); the earlier unverified list still stands (Apply of a fix answer re-running the launch on the real window, the start failure kind against a real boot log, Monitor run box and Studio rebuild after REG-324).
